identity.title: ALMA Census of Faint 1.2 mm Sources Down to ~ 0.02 mJy: Extragalactic Background Light and Dust-poor, High-z Galaxies

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present statistics of 133 faint 1.2-mm continuum sources detected in about 120 deep ALMA pointing data that include all the archival deep data available by 2015 June.

targets.name: 67 ALMA continuum maps (66 blank-field pointings, 1 Abell 1689 cluster mosaic)

evidence.quote: We construct a mass model for the cluster data (C) of A1689 at $z = 0.183$.

question.value: What fraction of the 1.2 mm extragalactic background light is resolved by faint (down to ~0.02 mJy) ALMA sources, and what is the physical nature (clustering, optical-NIR counterparts) of these sources?

evidence.quote: To understand the physical origin of our faint ALMA sources, we measure the galaxy bias $b_{g}$ by the counts-in-cells technique

analysis_steps.goal: Extract sources and estimate spurious fraction

evidence.quote: We use sources down to an SNR whose spurious source rate is $\lesssim 70$%, and adopt 3.4, 3.4, and $3.9\sigma$

method.value: Monte-Carlo injection of flux-scaled beams at random positions, SNR 3-7, 100 iterations per bin; fit 1-exp(a SNR - b)

evidence.quote: We fit the function of $1-\exp(a {\rm SNR} -b)$ to our completeness estimates, where $a$ and $b$ are free parameters.
